1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder; a solvent; and __a substrate surface, wherein the binder is a premixed solder paste__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and the binder comprises a material having thermal conductivity greater than epoxy__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __and the cavity-generating particles are affixed to the substrate surface by the binder__.

9. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising cavity generating particles, a binder, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles, __wherein the binder is a premixed solder paste__.

10. (Original) The composition of claim 9, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

11. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is __a thermally conductive premixed solder paste having thermal conductivity exceeding that of epoxy adhesives__.

12. (Original) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

13. (Original) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 pm in size.

14. (Original) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 pm in size.

15. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are __greater than 50 micrometers and__ 100-200 p m in size.

16. (Currently Amended) A composition of matter comprising carrier, binder, and cavity generating particles, wherein said composition of matter contains, in relative proportion: about 10 ml carrier; about 0.5 to 0.8 grams binder; and about 1 gram of cavity generating particles, __wherein the binder is a premixed solder paste__.

17. (Original) The composition of claim 16, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

18. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 16, wherein the binder is __a thermally conductive premixed solder paste having thermal conductivity exceeding that of epoxy adhesives__.

19. (Original) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

20. (Original) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 pm in size.

21. (Original) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 p m in size.

22. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are __greater than 50 micrometers and__ 100-200 m in size.
